skill.name: caveman
skill.description: Compress AI responses into terse caveman-style language while preserving technical accuracy, code blocks, warnings, and exact error text.
skill.summary: Use terse caveman-style responses to save tokens while keeping technical meaning intact.
skill.author: juliusbrussee

content.user_title: Compress Technical Replies With Caveman Mode
content.value_statement: Verbose answers can waste context and slow technical work. Caveman mode compresses explanations while keeping code, warnings, and technical meaning intact.
actual_capabilities: Compresses responses into lite, full, or ultra caveman styles.
Supports wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, and wenyan-ultra variants.
Keeps technical terms, code blocks, and exact error text unchanged.
Pauses terse style for security warnings and irreversible actions.
Lets users turn the style off with normal mode commands.
limitations: Does not execute code or inspect project files by itself.
May reduce conversational nuance in nontechnical discussions.
Can make complex multi-step explanations harder to follow if overused.
Does not measure actual token savings in each response.

use_cases.title: Shorten Debugging Answers
use_cases.description: Get concise root-cause explanations and next steps without losing technical details.

use_cases.title: Save Long Session Context
use_cases.description: Reduce response length during extended project work where every token matters.

use_cases.title: Create Dense Technical Notes
use_cases.description: Turn explanations into compact notes that preserve terms, warnings, and action items.

prompt_templates.title: Enable Caveman Mode
prompt_templates.prompt: Use caveman mode for this conversation. Keep technical terms exact and avoid filler.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Intensity
prompt_templates.prompt: /caveman lite. Explain this issue briefly, but keep full sentences and exact error names.

prompt_templates.title: Compress a Technical Explanation
prompt_templates.prompt: /caveman full. Explain why this design causes repeated database connections and give the fix.

prompt_templates.title: Use Maximum Compression
prompt_templates.prompt: /caveman ultra. Summarize this incident response plan into terse action steps and keep warnings clear.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced compression for long operational notes

output_examples.input: Explain why my React component re-renders when I pass an inline object prop.
output_examples.output: New object ref each render. Inline prop changes identity. Child sees new value. Memoize object or pass stable prop.

output_examples.input: Warn me before I delete a production table.
output_examples.output: Warning: This can permanently remove production data. Confirm backup, recovery plan, and target environment before continuing. Caveman resume after warning.

output_examples.input: Summarize why connection pooling helps under load.
output_examples.output: Pool reuses open DB connections. No new handshake per request. Less latency. Better throughput under load.

best_practices: Use lite mode when stakeholders need concise but polished language.
Use full or ultra mode only when the reader already knows the topic.
Switch to normal mode for legal, safety, or high-ambiguity explanations.
anti_patterns: Do not use terse mode when exact step order could be misunderstood.
Do not compress warnings until the risk and consequence are clear.
Do not use ultra mode for onboarding readers who need context.

faq.question: What does this skill change?
faq.answer: It changes response style. Answers become shorter, but technical terms and code blocks stay intact.

faq.question: Does it run commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill only gives style instructions for AI responses.

faq.question: Can I choose the compression level?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports lite, full, ultra, and three wenyan variants.

faq.question: Will it hide important warnings?
faq.answer: No. The skill says to drop terse style for security warnings and irreversible actions.

faq.question: How do I turn it off?
faq.answer: Ask for normal mode or say stop caveman.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
